title_en: Chinese Pop Songs (2/20): Jay Chou, the King of Pop Who Blends East and West
note_en: The 把 construction moves the object in front of the verb: 把说唱、节奏蓝调和古典音乐结合在一起 "combined rap, R&B, and classical music together," 把他当作学习的榜样 "take him as a role model." English simply puts the object after the verb, but Chinese uses 把 when the verb does something to the object and is followed by a result or destination such as 在一起, 进歌词 or 当作....
